goal: Iske baad aap array ko function mein pass kar sakte hain, samjha sakte hain ke function asli array kyun badalta hai, size ko doosre parameter ki tarah pass kar sakte hain, array ko const se mehfooz kar sakte hain, aur sum, maximum, reverse aur fill functions likh sakte hain.
warmup: Aap ki class teacher chahti hain ke 40 students ke marks check hon. Woh har helper ke liye 40 paper ki photocopy nahi karwati. Woh bas helper se kehti hain 'paper mere desk ke box mein hain'. Helper usi box tak jata hai. Agar woh kisi paper par correction likhe, to asli paper mein hi correct ho jati hai. Array receive karne wala function bhi aisa hi hai: usay array ki location milti hai, copy nahi.
definition: Jab aap function call mein array ka naam likhte hain, C++ array ki copy nahi banata. Woh pehle element ka address bhejta hai (array pointer mein 'decay' ho jata hai). To parameter int a[] asal mein pointer hai, aur parameter list mein int a[] aur int *a ka bilkul ek hi matlab hai. Do bade nataij: (1) function ASLI array par kaam karta hai, is liye jo bhi tabdeeli woh karta hai function ke return hone ke baad bhi rehti hai; (2) function ko sirf address milta hai, is liye usay pata nahi hota ke kitne elements hain. Aap ko size doosre parameter ki tarah bhejna parta hai, masalan int n.
howItWorks: Pehli trace step by step chalayein aur call stack dekhein. main array marks ka malik hai. Jab main sumArray(marks, 4) call karta hai, to stack par sumArray ka naya frame nazar aata hai. Usmein a hai (ek pointer jo main ke array ke ANDAR point karta hai) aur n hai (number 4 ki aam copy). Loop a[i] parhta hai, jo asal mein marks[i] hai. Jab function return hota hai to uska frame hat jata hai, lekin array wahin rehta hai kyunke woh main ka hai. Doosri trace mein doubleAll a[i] = a[i] * 2 likhta hai aur aap main mein data badalta dekhte hain: yeh is baat ka saboot hai ke koi copy nahi bani. Is liye jis function ko sirf numbers dekhne hon (sum, maximum, print) usay const int a[] likhna chahiye. Phir agar aap ghalti se a[i] = ... likhne ki koshish karein to compiler aap ko rok deta hai. Jis function ko array badalna ho (fill, reverse, sort, input) woh aam int a[] use karta hai. Call mein sirf naam likhein: sumArray(marks, 4), kabhi sumArray(marks[], 4) ya sumArray(marks[4], 4) nahi. Aakhir mein yaad rakhein ke function ke andar sizeof(a) sirf pointer ka size hota hai, is liye woh elements ki ginti nahi de sakta: hamesha n pass karein. 2-D array ke liye parameter mein column ka size likhna zaroori hai, masalan void show(int m[][3], int rows); (notes mein aap aur dekhenge).
